name: F#
note: F# keeps the OrdersController, OrderService and OrderStore in separate files, one type in each file. The attributes are F# attributes: RequestRoute on the controller type and GetRoute on its member declare GET /orders, and Public says that anyone may call its routes. A type takes the roles it needs as the parameters of its primary constructor, as Spring does with one constructor, so OrderService receives the OrderStore. F# runs on .NET: Tachyon compiles your F# code and adds the same protocol runtime that C# uses.
